nodes.name: PROMPT-ASSEMBLER-V4.md
nodes.summary: Implementation brief (v4) for the Waggle OS PromptAssembler feature, specifying type contracts, a scaffold-matrix algorithm for task-shape-aware prompt construction, a 6-scenario LiteLLM-backed eval harness, and acceptance criteria targeting measurable quality improvements across multilingual agent interactions.
nodes.languageNotes: 37-section technical spec covering feature-flag integration, model-tier contracts, Vitest unit tests, and a structured EVAL-RESULTS.md format — serves as the authoritative implementation contract for packages/agent prompt assembly.

nodes.name: WIKI-COMPILER-SPEC.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive product and technical specification for the Waggle Wiki Compiler — a personal knowledge synthesis engine that compiles memory frames into structured wiki pages, covering architecture, a universal source-ingestion pipeline (Obsidian, AI exports, MCP connectors), EU AI Act compliance mapping, privacy controls, dual-track (Waggle feature + hive-mind OSS) delivery plan, and competitive differentiation.
nodes.languageNotes: 77-section specification — the largest doc in this batch at 1687 lines. Covers packages/wiki-compiler and packages/hive-mind-mcp tracks with detailed cost models, wikilink formats, and open-source launch strategy targeting packages/hive-mind-wiki-compiler.

nodes.name: agent-backend-gaps.md
nodes.summary: Backend gap analysis spec for the agent system (status: complete as of 2026-03-26), documenting the required REST endpoints for personas, agent-groups, and jobs APIs, frontend-backend route mapping, and the reconciliation between 'personas' and 'agents' terminology — all six gap items were implemented.
